data.description: Dubai Mall Connected | 1 Bed with Downtown Views
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this elegant 1-bedroom apartment in Downtown Views, offering direct connectivity to Dubai Mall and a prime address in the heart of Downtown Dubai.

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area, floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light, a modern fully fitted kitchen with premium finishes, a spacious bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a contemporary bathroom. Enjoy stunning Downtown views from the comfort of your home, with a well-designed layout ideal for both end users and investors.

Property Features:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathroom
Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
Fully Fitted Modern Kitchen
Built-in Wardrobes
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Balcony
Downtown Views
Direct Access to Dubai Mall
Premium Amenities
Covered Parking

Residents enjoy world-class facilities including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, children's play area, landscaped leisure spaces, 24-hour security, and direct air-conditioned access to Dubai Mall, with Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, fine dining, and entertainment just moments away.
